## Summary

Describe the need and what this change does. Link the related issue or context if there is one.

## Validation

Describe checks performed and their results. For documentation or research, include source and link checks. Note anything unverified or still open.

## Review notes

Mention any decision, permission, or follow-up needed before merging. Confirm that shared material is appropriate for this repository's visibility and license. Remove this section if there is nothing to add.
